name: WIA Gold Limited
summary: WIA Gold Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the exploration and evaluation of mineral properties in Namibia and Côte d'Ivoire. The company explores for gold deposits. The company was formerly known as Tanga Resources Limited and changed its name to WIA Gold Limited in November 2021. WIA Gold Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Subiaco, Australia.
